item.title: Four Canadian service members die in Alberta base fire
item.description: Fire crews responded late Saturday as strong winds spread flames beyond Canadian Forces Base Wainwright into the surrounding rural area.

item.title: China may be stealth buyer of U.S. debt via Canada
item.description: Canada's holdings of U.S. Treasuries rose to $465 billion in August from $169 billion five years earlier.

item.title: Ex-Trump executive says ego hinders Trump's negotiating
item.description: “Any concession that should be made, he can’t make. Then, with the other parts of it, nothing can continue. He just has to win everything.”

item.title: Egypt's president vows to defend Saudi Arabia by any means, seeks authorization to deploy troops abroad as Houthi battle escalates
item.description: Parliament convened Sunday and will continue deliberations on Monday.
